projectDescription: A visual asset management system and headless CMS for artists and creatives to organize albums, build mosaic layouts, and serve content to any frontend via API.
keyFeatures: Album management — create and organize image collections with rich metadata and ordering
Mosaic builder — drag-and-drop visual layout composer with separate desktop and mobile grids
Dynamic entry types — flexible content structures (e.g. statements, case studies) configurable by admins
API-first architecture — read-only public API authenticated with API keys for embedding content anywhere
Per-user branding — custom logo, color themes, and display settings per account
Media management — upload, publish/unpublish, and reorder images across albums and entries
Dark mode support — full light and dark theme across the interface
Activity logging — complete audit trail of user actions
publicApiSurface: GET /api/entries/by-type/{type} — list entries filtered by entry type slug
X-API-Key header — API key authentication for all endpoints
